<div class="pluss-hero">
<div class="kicker">Pluss &middot; Space</div>
<h1>PlussTils</h1>
<p class="tagline">Cross-cutting utilities shared by every other space: filesystem pathing, the PlussView desktop viewer, and auxiliary helpers such as <code>OutputEngine</code>.</p>
<div class="pluss-hero-actions">
<a class="primary" href="api_reference.html">API Reference</a>
</div>
</div>

<div class="pluss-section">
<h2>What's in this space</h2>
<p class="section-sub">PlussTils has no table or numeric object of its own -- it's the toolbox every other space reaches for.</p>
<div class="pluss-package-grid">

<div class="pluss-card">
<span class="card-name">View</span>
<span class="card-model">PlussTils/view</span>
<p class="card-desc">The PlussView desktop viewer: architecture, window runtime, and the in-progress MATLAB-style popup viewer.</p>
</div>

<div class="pluss-card">
<span class="card-name">Pathing</span>
<span class="card-model">Not yet documented</span>
<p class="card-desc">Filesystem pathing helpers. Add a <code>docs/</code> folder next to this domain's source to have it appear here automatically.</p>
</div>

<div class="pluss-card">
<span class="card-name">Aux</span>
<span class="card-model">Not yet documented</span>
<p class="card-desc">Utility helpers including <code>pluss::tils::OutputEngine</code>. Add a <code>docs/</code> folder next to this domain's source to have it appear here automatically.</p>
</div>

</div>
</div>
</div>
